blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The latest oil price rollback does not make up for losses incurred by fisherfolk after weeks of successive price increases, according to activist fishers’ group Pambansang Lakas ng Kilusang Mamamalakaya ng Pilipinas (Pamalakaya). In a statement Tuesday, Sept. 29, Pamalakaya said fuel expenses had risen by more than P180 per fishing trip
